# Multistage Interpolation and Decimation\
\
Equivalent structures:\
\
![](https://spinlab.wpi.edu/courses/ece503_2014/images/baa11263cb7dca29753cfda5dcd0cc438908593490ab136a5c299c3b6d1b42c7.jpg)\
\
The main advantage of multistage interpolation and decimation is efficiency. Splitting interpolation and decimation into multiple steps avoids using computationally difficult narrowband filters. By up/downsampling in smaller steps, you can use simpler wideband lowpass filters in each stage.\
\
# Multistage Rational Sample Rate Conversion\
